decisions.reason: As an already established trommel screen that was effectively a renamed successor to a well-liked machine, it now carries both prior acceptance and accumulated commitment, making withdrawal within a year very unlikely.

This multi-model mobile shredder line reflects substantial development effort and public commitment, and after several years management would be inclined to justify that investment by continuing rather than exiting.

Although the visible commitment is lower than for the larger product lines, the stationary electric fine shredder fits the firm's resource-saving and tougher-processing direction, so management is still more likely to persist.
The green-waste grinder line extends the firm's mobile processing portfolio in a plausible niche, and sunk development plus strategic fit make a near-term withdrawal unlikely.

A dedicated page and several models indicate a strong public and resource commitment to the stationary pre-shredder line, so management would be reluctant to reverse course after keeping it this long.
